# ProDentim

> ProDentim is a Oral Probiotic / Dental Health Supplement. ProDentim is a chewable dietary supplement built around the idea that your mouth hosts its own community of bacteria. Rather than scrubbing, rinsing or masking, each tablet delivers a blend of probiotic strains plus selected plant and mineral ingredients intended to support the balance of that oral microbiome — and by extension, the comfort of your teeth and gums. It is a daily wellness habit, taken as a soft chewable tablet, meant to sit alongside normal brushing and flossing rather than replace them.
